player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long JoJoJoin, yumi pley long wanpela board 5x5 wantaim sel namba 0-24.
Long turn bilong yu, yu putim mak bilong yu long eni sel we i no gat mak, olsem '[12]'.
YU WIN sapos yu kisim FOA mak bilong yu i go stret — foa sel i go stret wantaim long sait, antap, o kona.
Olsem Player {player_id} yu '{symbol}'; opposen bilong yu '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dispela tok i no stret long pasin bilong raitim.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} em i no wanpela gutpela sel. Em mas stap namel long 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim mark bilong em ({symbol}) long sel {cell}.
